layers.name: Build and Release Scripts
layers.description: Handles the build, packaging, and release processes.

Manages linting and tests for the project.
folders.dev-docs: This folder contains configuration files for the project's documentation, including presets for Babel, configuration for Docusaurus, and sidebar settings.
folders.dev-docs/src: This folder contains documentation for the development environment, including initial data for the library.
folders.dev-docs/src/components: Highlights code snippets in the project.
folders.dev-docs/src/components/Homepage: This folder contains the source code for the homepage component of the software project, including its styles and features.
folders.dev-docs/src/css: This folder contains custom CSS styles that are applied globally across the project, using the Infima CSS framework.
folders.dev-docs/src/pages: This folder contains the source files for the homepage of the software project, including its CSS and TypeScript components.
folders.dev-docs/src/theme: This folder contains the MDX components for the theme, which are used to parse and render the content.
folders.dev-docs/src/theme/ReactLiveScope: This folder contains the React component for rendering the Excalidraw editor within the Docusaurus theme.
folders.examples/with-nextjs/src: This folder contains example components and styles for a Next.js application.
folders.examples/with-nextjs/src/app: This folder contains the Next.js application layout and page components.
folders.examples/with-nextjs/src/pages: This folder contains Next.js pages for the application, including a page that dynamically loads the Excalidraw component.
folders.examples/with-script-in-browser: This folder contains example files for a web application using React and Excalidraw, including components and utilities.
folders.examples/with-script-in-browser/componen: This folder contains components and styles for a web application that uses Excalidraw for drawing and a mobile footer component.
This folder contains components used in the sidebar of the application, including a sidebar component that renders its children.
folders.excalidraw-app: This folder contains the main application files for the Excalidraw project, including the main entry point, custom stats, iframe export, Jotai store, constants, bug issue template, collaboration debug, and Sentry configuration.
folders.excalidraw-app/app-language: Manages language-related functionalities in the application.
folders.excalidraw-app/collab: Manages collaboration features for Excalidraw, including user interactions and room management.
folders.excalidraw-app/components: This folder contains components used to build and customize the Excalidraw application, including the main menu, sidebar, footer, and welcome screen.
folders.excalidraw-app/data: Manages various data storage and synchronization functionalities for the Excalidraw application.
folders.excalidraw-app/share: This folder contains components and styles related to sharing and exporting drawings in the Excalidraw application.
folders.excalidraw-app/tests: Tests various components and functionalities of the Excalidraw application.
folders.packages/common: This folder contains common utility functions and utilities for debugging.
folders.packages/common/src: This folder contains various utility classes and functions used throughout the project, including event buses, binary heaps, bounds calculations, color manipulation, constants, editor interfaces, emitters, font metadata, and more.
folders.packages/common/tests: Contains test files for various common utilities and data structures.
folders.packages/element/src: This folder contains various classes and functions related to elements and their interactions within the Excalidraw application.
folders.packages/element/src/__tests__: Contains test files for various elements in the Excalidraw project, including flowcharts, sticky notes, and transformations.
folders.packages/element/src/arrows: Contains components and helper functions for arrow manipulation in the Excalidraw editor.
folders.packages/element/tests: These tests cover various aspects of the Excalidraw element library, including creating and selecting rectangles, bounding calculations, collision detection, cropping elements, and more.
folders.packages/excalidraw: This folder contains various utility and helper functions used throughout the Excalidraw application, including analytics tracking, drawing trails, clipboard operations, and more.
folders.packages/excalidraw/actions: This folder contains various action classes and predicates for handling different actions in the Excalidraw application, such as adding to a library, aligning elements, cropping, and deleting selected elements.
folders.packages/excalidraw/charts: This folder contains various chart rendering and parsing utilities for the Excalidraw project, including functions for rendering bar, line, radar, and Cartesian charts, as well as parsing spreadsheet data into chart elements.
folders.packages/excalidraw/components: This folder contains various components used in the Excalidraw application, including actions, dialogs, and drawing tools.
folders.packages/excalidraw/components/canvases: This folder contains components for rendering canvases in the Excalidraw application, including interactive and static canvases.
folders.packages/excalidraw/components/ColorPick: This folder contains components related to the color picker feature in the Excalidraw software project, including input fields, picker panels, and lists of colors.
folders.packages/excalidraw/components/CommandPa: Manages the command palette in the Excalidraw application, providing styles and functionality for displaying and interacting with commands.
folders.packages/excalidraw/components/DiagramTo: This folder contains the DiagramToCodePlugin component, which exports the DiagramToCodePlugin and imports React.
folders.packages/excalidraw/components/dropdownM: This folder contains components for creating dropdown menus in the Excalidraw application.
folders.packages/excalidraw/components/FontPicke: Manages the font picker component for selecting and displaying fonts in the application.
folders.packages/excalidraw/components/footer: This folder contains components and styles for the footer of the Excalidraw application.
folders.packages/excalidraw/components/hoc: This folder contains React Higher-Order Components (HOCs) for managing fallback rendering in the Excalidraw application.
folders.packages/excalidraw/components/hyperlink: This folder contains components and utilities for creating hyperlinks in the Excalidraw application.
folders.packages/excalidraw/components/live-coll: Manages live collaboration features for the application.
folders.packages/excalidraw/components/main-menu: This folder contains the main menu components for the Excalidraw application, including styles and logic for various menu items.
folders.packages/excalidraw/components/Overwrite: Manages the overwrite confirmation dialog for Excalidraw, including actions and state.
folders.packages/excalidraw/components/Sidebar: This folder contains components for the sidebar of the Excalidraw application, including styles, tests, and the main sidebar component.
folders.packages/excalidraw/components/Stats: This folder contains components that handle various statistical and measurement functionalities for the Excalidraw application.
folders.packages/excalidraw/components/TopPicksD: This folder contains components and utilities for implementing drag-and-drop functionality in the Top Picks section of the Excalidraw application, including context menus, tips, and drag-and-drop state management.
folders.packages/excalidraw/components/TTDDialog: This folder contains components related to the TTDDialog, which is a dialog for creating diagrams using Mermaid syntax.
This folder contains components for the chat interface of the Excalidraw application, including styles, interfaces, and logic for managing chat messages and history.
Manages chat functionalities, renders Mermaid diagrams, and handles text generation in Excalidraw components.
This folder contains utility functions and tests related to handling streams and parsing data for the Excalidraw application.
folders.packages/excalidraw/components/ViewportS: Manages the viewport status display in Excalidraw, including borders and badges.
folders.packages/excalidraw/components/welcome-s: This folder contains components and styles for the welcome screen of the Excalidraw application, including the main content, hints, and styling.
folders.packages/excalidraw/context: Manages tunnel connections and UI application state for Excalidraw.
folders.packages/excalidraw/css: This folder contains CSS files for styling the Excalidraw application, including variables and theme settings.
folders.packages/excalidraw/data: Manages local storage, file operations, and image encoding for Excalidraw, including handling encryption and metadata.
folders.packages/excalidraw/data/ai: This folder contains AI-related data and input types for the Excalidraw software project.
folders.packages/excalidraw/eraser: Manages the eraser trail in the Excalidraw application, handling the computation of text positions.
folders.packages/excalidraw/fonts: Manages font assets and descriptors for the Excalidraw editor.
folders.packages/excalidraw/fonts/Cascadia: This folder contains the Cascadia font faces used in the Excalidraw software project.
folders.packages/excalidraw/fonts/ComicShanns: This folder contains the ComicShanns font files and their corresponding font faces.
folders.packages/excalidraw/fonts/Emoji: Manages the font faces for emojis in the Excalidraw application.
folders.packages/excalidraw/fonts/Excalifont: This folder contains the Excalidraw font files and their corresponding font faces.
folders.packages/excalidraw/fonts/Helvetica: This folder contains the font files for the Helvetica font used in the Excalidraw project.
folders.packages/excalidraw/fonts/Liberation: This folder contains the Liberation font files used by Excalidraw for rendering text.
folders.packages/excalidraw/fonts/Lilita: This folder contains the Lilita font files used in the Excalidraw project.
folders.packages/excalidraw/fonts/Nunito: This folder contains the Nunito font files used by Excalidraw.
folders.packages/excalidraw/fonts/Virgil: This folder contains the font configuration for Excalidraw, defining the available fonts.
folders.packages/excalidraw/fonts/Xiaolai: This folder contains the font files for the Xiaolai font, which is used in the project.
folders.packages/excalidraw/hooks: This folder contains various utility hooks used across the Excalidraw application to manage state, events, and interactions.
folders.packages/excalidraw/lasso: This folder contains the implementation of the Lasso tool in the Excalidraw project, which allows users to select multiple elements by drawing a lasso around them.
folders.packages/excalidraw/renderer: This folder contains various rendering utilities and components for the Excalidraw application, including animation, scene rendering, and element rendering.
folders.packages/excalidraw/scene: Manages rendering and exporting of scenes in the Excalidraw application.
folders.packages/excalidraw/subset: This folder contains modules for font subsetting, including a main file for worker-based operations and shared code.
folders.packages/excalidraw/subset/harfbuzz: This folder contains TypeScript bindings for Harfbuzz, a text shaping library, and a loader for Harfbuzz subsets.
folders.packages/excalidraw/subset/woff2: This folder contains TypeScript files that handle WOFF2 font loading and parsing.
folders.packages/excalidraw/tests: Contains test files for various components and functionalities of the Excalidraw application, using React, Vitest, and other libraries.
folders.packages/excalidraw/tests/data: This folder contains test files for the Excalidraw project, focusing on element reconciliation and restoration functionalities.
folders.packages/excalidraw/tests/fixtures: Contains test fixtures for Excalidraw elements and diagrams.
folders.packages/excalidraw/tests/helpers: Contains helper functions and constants for testing ExcALIDRAW, including API, colorization, constants, mocks, polyfills, and UI components.
folders.packages/excalidraw/tests/packages: Tests event callbacks for the Excalidraw package.
folders.packages/excalidraw/tests/queries: This folder contains test files for querying DOM elements and tool-specific queries in the Excalidraw project.
folders.packages/excalidraw/tests/scene: Tests the scene module of the Excalidraw application.
folders.packages/excalidraw/wysiwyg: This folder contains components and utilities for text editing within the WYSIWYG editor of the Excalidraw project.
folders.packages/fractional-indexing/src: This folder contains the source code for fractional indexing, including utilities for generating and validating keys.
folders.packages/laser-pointer/src: This folder contains the source code for a laser pointer application, including classes and functions for managing laser pointer settings and calculations.
folders.packages/math/src: This folder contains various mathematical functions and utilities for geometric calculations, including angle, curve, ellipse, line, PCA, point, polygon, and range operations.
folders.packages/math/tests: Contains test files for mathematical operations and calculations.
folders.packages/utils/src: This folder contains utility functions and classes used for exporting and manipulating shapes in the software project.
folders.packages/utils/tests: Contains test files for various utility functions and components in the project.
folders.public: Manages the service worker for the public directory.
folders.scripts: This folder contains scripts used for building, packaging, and releasing the software project.
folders.scripts/woff2: Contains plugins for building and serving WOFF2 fonts using ESBuild and Vite.
